items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 重新审视运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学见解
items.summaryZh: 这项针对267名运动神经元病患者的大型回顾性研究发现，75%的患者存在体感诱发电位（SEP）异常，且在上运动神经元为主和ALS/下运动神经元为主两组间无差异。SEP异常与运动诱发电位（MEP）异常无关联，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋是独立于运动通路损伤的现象。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS作为多系统网络疾病提供了新的神经生理学证据，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋可能是独立于运动皮层损伤的病理特征，这对理解疾病机制和开发感觉功能相关的生物标志物具有参考价值。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统性地调查一大组运动神经元病（MND）患者中体感诱发电位（SEP）的异常情况，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEPs）及临床表型的关系。我们回顾性分析了267名确诊为MND并接受标准化SEP和经颅磁刺激检查的患者。患者被分为纯/主要上运动神经元（UMN）组和纯/主要下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）组。SEP异常通过内部规范数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低和N20-P25波幅增加。MEPs由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。75%的患者检测到至少一种SEP异常，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增加，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的躯体感觉皮层过度兴奋。相比之下，异常MEPs在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP发现之间未发现显著关联。上下肢SEP潜伏期强相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增加与潜伏期异常无相关性。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且在很大程度上独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍。SEP波幅增加可能反映原发性皮层感觉过度兴奋，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND是一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并强调SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大型队列数据，揭示了SEP异常在MND中独立于运动通路损伤的高发性，为ALS作为多系统网络疾病提供了新近的临床神经生理学证据。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章指出，ALS早期临床试验中普遍存在夸大疗效、误用生物标志物、选择性报告结果等问题，导致许多2期结果无法在3期试验中重现。作者呼吁改革激励机制，强调科学严谨性，并建议更严格地筛选2期项目，以恢复ALS临床试验的可信度。
items.insight: 该文章系统梳理了ALS临床试验中反复出现的科学谬误及其背后的激励扭曲，为研究者提供了审视自身试验设计和结果解读的批判性框架，有助于减少无效疗法的过早推进。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS早期临床试验中的夸大宣称和不当激励导致3期失败率高，需加强方法学严谨性和结果报告标准。
aiRead.limitation: 作为观点文章，不包含原始数据或系统性证据评估，其建议基于作者对领域现状的观察。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否出现针对2期试验设计或结果报告标准的具体指南更新，以及相关案例研究。

items.abstractZh: 早期和中期的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）临床试验数据长期以来被用于宣称临床获益，但这些获益最终未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。我们认为，由“临床试验工业复合体”产生的不当激励助长了错误的科学推理，该复合体极大地影响了试验设计、数据解读和结果传播。反复出现的谬误包括：结果比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标之间的不匹配、结果的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对不确定数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在工业和学术界错位激励的强化下，导致过早宣称治疗前景，并对患者造成切实伤害。为解决由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度差距，我们呼吁严格遵守既定的临床试验结果报告标准，明确区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的筛选。转向科学怀疑主义和方法论严谨性的文化变革对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论发表于2026年，直接针对ALS临床试验领域长期存在的可信度危机，提出改革建议，对当前ALS疗法开发策略具有即时指导价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.

items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 本文评论了 ATXN2 基因相关疾病遗传模式的复杂性，指出除了传统的常染色体显性遗传外，还存在隐性遗传、重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量效应等机制，可能涉及功能丧失致病。这对 ALS 的遗传风险评估和分层治疗有重要启示。
items.insight: 该评论挑战了 ATXN2 相关疾病仅由显性功能获得机制驱动的传统观点，提出隐性遗传和功能丧失机制也可能参与，这对 ALS 患者的遗传咨询和未来治疗策略（如反义寡核苷酸）的适用性有直接影响。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅限于显性遗传，隐性遗传和功能丧失机制在某些情况下可能参与发病。
aiRead.limitation: 评论基于单一病例报告，缺乏大规模功能验证，机制推断尚需实验支持。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对 ATXN2 隐性突变或功能丧失的细胞/动物模型研究，以及携带不同重复中断变体的 ALS 患者的临床试验分层数据。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性疾病的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来关于主要常染色体显性、功能获得性驱动机制的假设。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能因重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能丧失机制在某些情况下有助于发病机制。我们讨论了对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，强调遗传分层的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论基于 2026 年最新病例报告，重新审视 ATXN2 的遗传模式，为 ALS 的遗传分层和精准治疗提供新视角。

items.title: Poor Prognostic Factors After Gastrostomy in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Two-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) is widely used to manage dysphagia in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, some patients experience rapid clinical deterioration following the procedure. Prognostic factors specific to outcomes following PEG remain insufficiently defined. This two-center retrospective cohort study included 117 patients with ALS who underwent PEG prior to tracheostomy between April 2011 and June 2023. Cox proportional hazards modeling was used to identify independent prognostic factors following PEG. Explanatory variables included age, sex, onset site, percent of normal forced vital capacity (%FVC), disease duration from onset to PEG, and body mass index. Optimal cutoff values for continuous variables were determined using time-dependent receiver operating characteristic analyses. Among six examined clinical variables, four were independently associated with worse outcomes after PEG placement as follows: male sex, spinal onset, lower %FVC at the time of PEG, and shorter duration from onset to PEG. Cutoff values were determined as %FVC < 63% and disease duration < 12 months. Log-rank analyses confirmed significantly shorter post-PEG survival in patients meeting these criteria. Poorer respiratory function and shorter duration from disease onset to PEG were strongly associated with worse prognosis after PEG. Male sex emerged as an independent prognostic factor, suggesting potential biological differences in disease progression after gastrostomy. These findings underscore the importance of comprehensive clinical evaluation when considering PEG in patients with ALS.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者胃造口术后不良预后因素：一项双中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项双中心回顾性研究分析了117例ALS患者，发现四个因素与胃造口术后更差的预后独立相关：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时用力肺活量低于63%、从起病到PEG时间短于12个月。呼吸功能越差、病程越短就做胃造口，术后生存期越短。研究提示临床决策需综合评估，而非仅依据吞咽困难程度。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS患者胃造口术的时机选择提供了量化参考（%FVC≥63%、病程≥12个月可能更有利），并首次强调男性作为独立不良预后因素，提示性别可能影响术后疾病轨迹，值得在临床实践和后续机制研究中关注。

items.abstractZh: 经皮内镜下胃造口术（PEG）广泛用于管理肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的吞咽困难。然而，部分患者在术后出现快速临床恶化。针对PEG术后结局的特异性预后因素仍定义不足。这项双中心回顾性队列研究纳入了2011年4月至2023年6月期间在气管切开术前接受PEG的117例ALS患者。采用Cox比例风险模型识别PEG术后的独立预后因素。解释变量包括年龄、性别、起病部位、用力肺活量占预计值百分比（%FVC）、从起病到PEG的病程以及体重指数。连续变量的最佳截断值通过时间依赖性受试者工作特征分析确定。在检查的六个临床变量中，四个与PEG置入后较差结局独立相关，具体为：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时较低的%FVC以及从起病到PEG的较短病程。截断值确定为%FVC < 63%和病程 < 12个月。Log-rank分析证实，符合这些标准的患者PEG术后生存期显著缩短。较差的呼吸功能和从疾病起病到PEG的较短病程与PEG术后较差预后密切相关。男性作为独立预后因素出现，提示胃造口术后疾病进展可能存在生物学差异。这些发现强调了在考虑对ALS患者进行PEG时进行全面临床评估的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2011-2023年近期队列数据，为ALS患者胃造口术这一常见临床操作提供了新的量化预后分层指标，具有直接的临床转化价值。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究系统梳理了ALS相关环状RNA（circRNA）的证据，并通过生物信息学分析发现circRNA可能通过调控未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期和凋亡等通路参与ALS发病。研究还提示circRNA可海绵吸附多种RNA结合蛋白，且ALS相关FUS突变会改变其与circRNA的结合能力。患者组织RNA-seq数据支持circRNA宿主基因表达异常。该研究为circRNA作为ALS生物标志物或治疗靶点提供了前期线索。
items.insight: 该研究将circRNA这一非编码RNA类别系统性地与ALS病理机制联系起来，并整合了患者组织数据，提示circRNA可能作为疾病修饰的潜在节点，值得ALS研究者关注其在生物标志物和靶向干预方面的后续验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾以识别与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的ALS相关数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20种RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析表明，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与circRNAs的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受累的中枢神经系统中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因及枢纽蛋白的表达存在显著改变。总之，我们的研究结果将circRNAs确定为ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，结合系统文献回顾、计算机模拟和患者RNA-seq数据，新近地揭示了circRNA在ALS中的多层面调控作用，具有明确的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Nuclear SOD1 links ATM-CHK2 signaling to ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A cellular models of ALS.
items.summary: The activity of S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (ADH5/GSNOR) has been proposed being essential to limit oxidative stress and preserve mitochondrial quality control. Here we identify a redox-dependent ATM-CHK2-SOD1 signaling axis that drives ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SH-SY5Y cells expressing the ALS-associated SOD1 G93A mutant. ATM-CHK2 activation promotes the interaction of SOD1 with CHK2, leading to SOD1 nuclear translocation and binding to the ADH5 promoter. Pharmacological inhibition of ATM or CHK2 abolishes these effects. ADH5/GSNOR overexpression protects cells from SOD1 G93A -induced toxicity suggesting that the modulation of GSNOR activity may represent a potential strategy to restore redox homeostasis in ALS.
items.titleZh: 核SOD1将ATM-CHK2信号与ALS SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A细胞模型中的ADH5/GSNOR转录联系起来
items.summaryZh: 这项细胞研究发现了一条新的信号通路：在表达SOD1 G93A突变体的细胞中，ATM-CHK2激活促使SOD1进入细胞核，进而启动抗氧化酶ADH5/GSNOR的转录。抑制ATM或CHK2会阻断这一过程，而过表达ADH5/GSNOR能减轻突变SOD1的毒性。该研究提示，增强GSNOR活性可能有助于对抗ALS中的氧化应激。
items.insight: 该研究首次将ATM-CHK2 DNA损伤应答通路与SOD1的核功能及GSNOR转录调控联系起来，为SOD1相关ALS的氧化还原失衡机制提供了新的分子解释，并指出了GSNOR作为潜在治疗靶点的可能性。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATM-CHK2信号通路通过促进SOD1核转位并使其结合ADH5启动子来驱动GSNOR转录，且GSNOR过表达可减轻SOD1 G93A毒性。

items.abstractZh: S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽还原酶（ADH5/GSNOR）的活性被认为对于限制氧化应激和维持线粒体质量控制至关重要。本研究在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变体的SH-SY5Y细胞中，鉴定出一条氧化还原依赖的ATM-CHK2-SOD1信号轴，该轴驱动ADH5/GSNOR转录。ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1与CHK2的相互作用，导致SOD1核转位并结合至ADH5启动子。药理学抑制ATM或CHK2可消除这些效应。ADH5/GSNOR过表达可保护细胞免受SOD1 G93A诱导的毒性，提示调节GSNOR活性可能成为恢复ALS中氧化还原稳态的潜在策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了SOD1在细胞核内的新功能及其与ATM-CHK2信号通路的交叉对话，为SOD1-ALS的病理机制和潜在治疗策略提供了新的转化研究方向。

items.title: Clinical and immunological characterization of a child with a homozygous TBK1 kinase-domain truncation.
items.summary: TBK1 is a serine-tyrosine kinase protein that transmits signals from pattern recognition receptors to the NF-κB pathway leading to production of Type 1 Interferons. Mutations in this protein have been associated with arthritis, vasculitis, herpes simplex encephalitis and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In the current study, we characterized the functional consequences of a TBK1-variant bearing a truncation in exon 4 and 5 in a patient with poly arthritis resembling juvenile idiopathic arthritis and necrotizing encephalitis. The truncation was associated with reduced TBK1 protein abundance and altered phosphorylation. The variant was associated with increased basal/and or Poly-I: C induced IL-6, TNFα, IL-1β and IL-18 and type 1 Interferon ex vivo. Our findings expand the phenotypic spectrum of TBK1 loss-of-function variants and may provide insight into the management of immune dysregulation in affected patients.
items.titleZh: 一例纯合TBK1激酶结构域截短患儿的临床与免疫学特征
items.summaryZh: 本研究报道了一名携带TBK1基因激酶结构域纯合截短突变的患儿，其临床表现为多关节炎（类似幼年特发性关节炎）合并坏死性脑炎。研究发现该突变导致TBK1蛋白表达减少和磷酸化异常，并增强多种炎症因子（IL-6、TNFα、IL-1β、IL-18）和I型干扰素的产生。该病例扩展了TBK1功能缺失相关疾病的临床谱系。
items.insight: TBK1是ALS中公认的致病基因之一，但该研究揭示其纯合截短突变可导致严重的自身炎症和神经炎症表型，提示TBK1功能缺失在神经退行性病变中的免疫机制可能比以往认为的更复杂，对理解ALS中TBK1变异的致病机制具有参考价值。

items.abstractZh: TBK1是一种丝氨酸-酪氨酸激酶蛋白，可将信号从模式识别受体传递至NF-κB通路，从而诱导I型干扰素的产生。该蛋白的突变与关节炎、血管炎、单纯疱疹病毒性脑炎及肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）相关。本研究对一名表现为类似幼年特发性关节炎的多关节炎合并坏死性脑炎患者中携带外显子4和5截短的TBK1变异体的功能后果进行了表征。该截短与TBK1蛋白丰度降低及磷酸化改变相关。该变异与离体条件下基础水平和/或Poly-I:C诱导的IL-6、TNFα、IL-1β、IL-18及I型干扰素水平升高相关。我们的发现扩展了TBK1功能缺失变异的表型谱，并可能为受影响患者的免疫失调管理提供见解。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，通过单例纯合截短突变的功能表征，将TBK1功能缺失与神经炎症和免疫失调直接关联，为ALS相关基因的免疫病理机制提供了新证据。

items.title: Tracking Socio-emotional Brain Changes in Premanifest C9orf72 Repeat Expansion Carriers: A Structural and Functional 2-Year Longitudinal Magnetic Resonance Imaging Study.
items.summary: The C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion (C9RE) is the most frequent genetic cause of frontotemporal dementia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Although structural alterations have been reported decades before symptom onset, the longitudinal evolution of socioemotional network dysfunction in premanifest C9RE carriers remains poorly understood. In this multimodal 2-year longitudinal study, we examined 21 premanifest C9RE carriers and 24 controls using structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), resting-state, and task-based functional MRI (fMRI), and multivariate pattern analysis. Participants completed facial emotion processing tasks during fMRI scanning, alongside behavioral assessments. We assessed regional activation, network connectivity, and voxel-wise structural integrity at baseline and follow up. At baseline, premanifest C9RE carriers showed reduced emotion recognition efficiency, accompanied by bilateral thalamic atrophy, decreased activation in the anterior and posterior cingulate cortex, and increased activation in the posterior cerebellum, along with altered multivoxel activity patterns in the anterior cingulate and posterior cerebellum. Resting-state fMRI revealed decreased functional connectivity involving the thalamus, anterior, and posterior cingulate cortex. Longitudinal analyses indicated declining emotion-evoked responses in the posterior cingulate cortex and cerebellum, alongside further thalamic volume loss, whereas functional connectivity showed no significant change over time. Despite these progressive neural alterations, behavioral performance remained stable. Socioemotional circuit dysfunction emerges early in C9RE carriers and progresses over time, preceding overt clinical symptoms. Functional imaging, especially task-based fMRI combined with multivariate pattern analysis, captures early circuit-level alterations that may serve as sensitive biomarkers for premanifest neurodegeneration. ANN NEUROL 2026.
items.titleZh: 追踪症状前C9orf72重复扩增携带者的社会情感脑变化：一项为期2年的纵向结构与功能磁共振成像研究
items.summaryZh: 这项为期2年的纵向研究追踪了21名尚未出现症状的C9orf72突变携带者，发现其社会情感脑网络（包括丘脑、扣带皮层和小脑）在临床症状出现前就已出现功能与结构异常，且随时间推移逐渐加重。值得注意的是，尽管脑部变化在进展，参与者的行为表现保持稳定，提示脑成像可能比行为测试更早捕捉到疾病信号。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统展示了C9orf72突变携带者在症状前阶段社会情感网络的纵向演变轨迹，提示任务态fMRI结合多变量模式分析可能成为监测ALS/FTD遗传高危人群疾病进程的敏感工具，对设计未来预防性临床试验的终点指标具有重要参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 症状前C9orf72携带者在基线即存在社会情感网络的结构与功能异常，且这些异常在2年内呈进行性发展，但行为表现保持稳定。

items.abstractZh: C9orf72六核苷酸重复扩增（C9RE）是额颞叶痴呆和肌萎缩侧索硬化最常见的遗传学病因。尽管在症状出现前数十年就已报道结构改变，但症状前C9RE携带者社会情感网络功能障碍的纵向演变仍知之甚少。在这项多模态2年纵向研究中，我们使用结构磁共振成像（MRI）、静息态和任务态功能MRI（fMRI）以及多变量模式分析，检查了21名症状前C9RE携带者和24名对照者。参与者在fMRI扫描期间完成面部情绪处理任务，并接受行为评估。我们在基线和随访时评估了区域激活、网络连接性和体素级结构完整性。在基线时，症状前C9RE携带者表现出情绪识别效率降低，伴有双侧丘脑萎缩、前扣带皮层和后扣带皮层激活减少、后小脑激活增加，以及前扣带皮层和后小脑的多体素活动模式改变。静息态fMRI显示涉及丘脑、前扣带皮层和后扣带皮层的功能连接性降低。纵向分析表明，后扣带皮层和小脑的情绪诱发反应下降，同时丘脑体积进一步减少，而功能连接性随时间无显著变化。尽管存在这些进行性神经改变，行为表现保持稳定。社会情感回路功能障碍在C9RE携带者中早期出现并随时间进展，先于明显的临床症状。功能成像，尤其是任务态fMRI结合多变量模式分析，可捕获早期回路水平改变，可能作为症状前神经退行性变的敏感生物标志物。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提供了C9orf72突变携带者症状前阶段社会情感网络随时间退化的纵向证据，具有直接的ALS遗传学相关性和转化生物标志物价值。

items.title: Emergencies in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Emergencies are frequent in people living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (pALS), especially as the disease progresses, and can necessitate urgent evaluation and intervention. Progressive weakness in ALS inevitably increases fall risk, making discussion of fall prevention strategies integral to caring for pALS. Thromboembolic events and respiratory failure may present insidiously in ALS, requiring a high index of clinical suspicion, and management strategies differ from those for individuals without ALS. Bulbar impairment in ALS can give rise to aspiration, laryngospasm, and malnutrition leading to emergency department (ED) visits, underscoring the need for early consideration of gastrostomy tube placement. PALS face an increased risk of serious infections, making vigilant monitoring for any acute change essential. Tracheostomy and gastrostomy, although life-sustaining measures in ALS, may require ED care when complications arise. Proactive assessment and management are critical to prevent complications related to constipation, urinary dysfunction, cognitive and behavioral issues. Although serious adverse events from ALS treatments are very rare, potential immune-mediated neurologic complications are a consideration with tofersen use. Importantly, ALS emergencies should be viewed as potential indicators of disease progression, prompting timely serious illness discussions and reassessment of goals of care. Anticipation of potential complications and emergencies, combined with an understanding of appropriate evaluation and evidence-based management, constitute critical components of caring for pALS. Early recognition and proactive management of these emergencies can improve safety, reduce avoidable hospitalizations, and support goal-concordant, patient-centered care.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症的急症处理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦ALS患者病程中常见的急症问题，包括跌倒、血栓栓塞、呼吸衰竭、误吸、感染以及气管切开和胃造口相关并发症。文章强调，ALS急症常是疾病进展的信号，临床医生应主动评估和预防，并适时启动关于护理目标和严重疾病预后的沟通。
items.insight: 该综述系统梳理了ALS病程中容易被忽视的急症场景及其与普通人群不同的管理策略，为临床医生提供了从预防到急诊处理的实用框架，有助于减少可避免的住院并优化以患者为中心的护理决策。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS急症（如跌倒、呼吸衰竭、误吸、感染等）是疾病进展的常见表现，需要高度警惕和主动管理，且管理策略与普通人群不同；急症出现时应及时讨论护理目标。
aiRead.limitation: 作为叙述性综述，未提供系统检索方法和证据分级，具体推荐意见的循证强度需进一步核实。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注ALS患者急诊就诊原因的前瞻性队列研究，以及针对特定急症（如呼吸衰竭、血栓栓塞）干预策略的随机对照试验。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者（pALS）中急症频发，尤其是在疾病进展期，可能需要紧急评估和干预。ALS中进行性肌无力不可避免地增加跌倒风险，因此讨论跌倒预防策略是护理pALS不可或缺的一部分。血栓栓塞事件和呼吸衰竭在ALS中可能隐匿起病，需要高度临床警惕，且其管理策略与无ALS的个体不同。ALS中的延髓功能障碍可导致误吸、喉痉挛和营养不良，进而导致急诊科（ED）就诊，这强调了早期考虑胃造口管置入的必要性。pALS面临严重感染风险增加，因此对任何急性变化进行警惕性监测至关重要。气管切开术和胃造口术虽然是ALS的生命维持措施，但当出现并发症时可能需要急诊处理。主动评估和管理对于预防便秘、泌尿功能障碍、认知和行为问题相关的并发症至关重要。尽管ALS治疗引起的严重不良事件非常罕见，但使用托夫生（tofersen）时需考虑潜在的免疫介导的神经系统并发症。重要的是，ALS急症应被视为疾病进展的潜在指标，促使及时进行严重疾病讨论和重新评估护理目标。预见潜在的并发症和急症，结合对适当评估和循证管理的理解，是护理pALS的关键组成部分。早期识别和主动管理这些急症可以提高安全性，减少可避免的住院，并支持与目标一致的、以患者为中心的护理。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，系统整合了ALS急症管理的最新循证策略，直接回应了临床护理中高发的急症识别与处理需求，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: The Role of overdose Folic Acid in Promoting Neuroinflammation, Oxidative Stress, and Apoptosis in SOD1-G93A Mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative condition that involves the targeted degeneration of motor neurons. The precise pathogenetic mechanisms are still largely unclear. In this study, we utilized the SOD1-G93A mouse model of ALS to investigate the effects of folic acid (FA), an important factor involved in homocysteine metabolism. Our results indicated that a little FA prolong the lifespan of the SOD1-G93A mice and medium and high dose FA significantly shortened the lifespan of the SOD1-G93A mice. Furthermore, we observed that overdose FA significantly elevated inflammation levels in the cerebellum, as evidenced by increased concentrations of tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), Interleukin-1β (IL-1β), Cluster of Differentiation 68 (CD68), Cluster of Differentiation 86 (CD86), and Monocyte Chemoattractant Protein-1 (MCP-1), facilitating microglial activation. The low dose FA were the opposite of the overdose FA. Additionally, high dose FA increased the levels of phosphorylated p65 (p-p65)/p65, thereby promoting the NF-κB signaling pathway. Conversely, high dose FA inhibited the expression of total superoxide dismutase (T-SOD) while increasing the level of malondialdehyde (MDA) in the cerebellum; these effects were not observed in muscle tissue. Moreover, high dose FA elevated the levels of Bax2/Bcl-2. Concurrently, high dose FA induced increased apoptosis in SOD1-G93A mice, as demonstrated by TUNEL staining. Notably, the brain iron content of SOD1-G93A mice remained unchanged following FA treatment. These findings provide evidence that overdose FA supplementation may exert pro-inflammatory effects by promoting the NF-κB pathway, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in the context of ALS.
items.titleZh: 过量叶酸在SOD1-G93A小鼠中促进神经炎症、氧化应激和细胞凋亡的作用
items.summaryZh: 这项在小鼠模型上的研究发现，叶酸对ALS的影响呈剂量依赖性：低剂量叶酸可延长SOD1-G93A小鼠寿命，而中高剂量则缩短寿命。过量叶酸会加重大脑（小脑）的神经炎症、氧化应激和细胞凋亡，其机制涉及激活NF-κB信号通路。研究提示，ALS患者补充叶酸需谨慎，过量可能有害。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS患者常见的营养补充剂——叶酸——提供了关键的剂量-安全性警示，提示过量摄入可能通过加重神经炎症而加速疾病进展，对临床营养管理具有直接参考价值。

aiRead.studyType: 动物实验（SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: 叶酸对SOD1-G93A小鼠寿命的影响呈倒U型：低剂量有益，中高剂量有害；高剂量叶酸通过激活NF-κB通路、诱导氧化应激和细胞凋亡加剧小脑神经炎症。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于小鼠模型，结果外推至人类ALS患者需谨慎；未检测叶酸对脊髓运动神经元及肌肉功能的影响；脑铁含量检测可能不足以全面反映铁代谢状态。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否开展人体研究以确定ALS患者的安全叶酸补充剂量范围，以及NF-κB通路抑制剂能否逆转高剂量叶酸的负面效应。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种涉及运动神经元靶向退化的神经退行性疾病，其确切发病机制仍 largely 不清楚。本研究利用 SOD1-G93A ALS 小鼠模型，探讨了参与同型半胱氨酸代谢的重要因子叶酸（FA）的作用。结果显示，少量 FA 延长了 SOD1-G93A 小鼠的寿命，而中、高剂量 FA 则显著缩短了其寿命。此外，过量 FA 显著提高了小脑中的炎症水平，表现为肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、分化簇 68（CD68）、分化簇 86（CD86）和单核细胞趋化蛋白-1（MCP-1）浓度增加，促进了小胶质细胞活化。低剂量 FA 的作用与过量 FA 相反。高剂量 FA 还增加了磷酸化 p65（p-p65）/p65 的水平，从而促进 NF-κB 信号通路。相反，高剂量 FA 抑制了小脑中总超氧化物歧化酶（T-SOD）的表达，同时增加了丙二醛（MDA）的水平；这些效应在肌肉组织中未观察到。此外，高剂量 FA 提高了 Bax2/Bcl-2 的水平。同时，TUNEL 染色显示高剂量 FA 诱导 SOD1-G93A 小鼠细胞凋亡增加。值得注意的是，FA 处理后 SOD1-G93A 小鼠的脑铁含量保持不变。这些发现证明，在 ALS 背景下，过量补充 FA 可能通过促进 NF-κB 通路、氧化应激和细胞凋亡而发挥促炎作用。

items.title: Progress towards a biotypic biomarker profile for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal spectrum disorders.
items.summary: Determining the optimal timing of disease-modifying therapies for neurodegenerative disorders will necessitate identification of when the underlying pathobiological process becomes active, well in advance of the point at which clinical manifestions appear. Phenoconversion, the emergence of clinically manifest syndomes, may be preceded by years to decades of silent pathobiological activity that can only be mapped by an array of biomarkers. ALS and FTD, traditionally identified as distinct clinical syndromes, are increasingly recognized to exist along a spectrum of clinical syndromes with shared genetic risk and shared underlying pathology. This clinicopathological spectrum is underpinned by cytoplasmic aggregation of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) as the common neuropathological hallmark. In contrast, the majority of neuropathologically-defined frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) is associated with alterations in either TDP-43 metabolism (FTLD-TDP) or of the microtubule associated protein tau (FTLD-tau), with a smaller percentage associated with either autosomal dominant genetic mutations or impairments in the ubiquitin proteasome system. As the field of neurodegenerative disorders increasingly shifts towards the frameworks of a pathobiological definition of disease, there is a growing imperative to develop biomarkers that reflect the varied pathobiologies that underly these disorders, and to determine the sensitivity of such biomarkers to detect the presence of these pathobiologies before phenoconversion. To that end, an international workshop was convened in London, Canada in 2025 to review the evidence for existing or evolving biomarkers suitable for (1) the detection of either ALS or FTD pathobiology prior to phenoconversion and/or (2) predict phenoconversion in at risk individuals. Such biomarkers might be conceptualized as "biotypic biomarkers", capturing their ability to describe an underlying pathophysiology whilst being agnostic to the emergent clinical manifestations. Whereas no single biotypic marker is yet able to predict the emergence of ALS, FTD or their intersection, a multimodal approach to developing a biotypic biomarker profile holds promise for the detection of relevant pathobiological processes. The strength of such an approach would be augmented by also addressing issues of resiliency/susceptibility both in terms of genetic risk susceptibility profiles and developing sensitive biomarkers of genomic and cellular aging. By including such nontraditional markers of disease, a more robust picture of not only the degenerative process but also of those factors that might potentially mitigate or drive a heightened probability of disease can be derived.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化-额颞叶谱系障碍生物型生物标志物谱的进展
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述基于2025年国际研讨会，探讨ALS和FTD作为连续谱系疾病的生物标志物策略。核心观点是，在临床症状出现前数年甚至数十年，病理过程已悄然启动，因此需要开发能反映潜在病理生物学的“生物型”生物标志物，以预测表型转化。目前尚无单一标志物能预测ALS或FTD，但多模态组合（包括遗传风险、细胞衰老标志物等）可能提供更全面的评估。
items.insight: 该文为ALS研究者提供了生物标志物开发的前沿框架，强调从临床综合征定义转向病理生物学定义，并指出多模态生物型标志物谱是未来预测和早期干预的关键方向，对设计临床试验和识别高风险个体具有指导意义。

items.abstractZh: 确定神经退行性疾病疾病修饰治疗的最佳时机，需要识别潜在病理生物学过程何时变得活跃，这远早于临床表现的出现。表型转化（即临床显性综合征的出现）之前可能存在数年至数十年的无症状病理生物学活动，只能通过一系列生物标志物来描绘。ALS和FTD传统上被视为不同的临床综合征，但日益被认为存在于一个共享遗传风险和共享潜在病理的临床综合征谱系中。这一临床病理谱系以TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）的胞质聚集为共同的神经病理学标志。相比之下，大多数神经病理学定义的额颞叶变性（FTLD）与TDP-43代谢改变（FTLD-TDP）或微管相关蛋白tau的改变（FTLD-tau）相关，较小比例与常染色体显性遗传突变或泛素蛋白酶体系统损伤相关。随着神经退行性疾病领域日益转向疾病的病理生物学定义框架，越来越需要开发反映这些疾病潜在多样病理生物学的生物标志物，并确定这些生物标志物在表型转化前检测这些病理生物学存在的敏感性。为此，2025年在加拿大伦敦召开了一次国际研讨会，审查现有或新兴生物标志物的证据，这些标志物适用于（1）在表型转化前检测ALS或FTD病理生物学，和/或（2）预测高风险个体的表型转化。此类生物标志物可概念化为“生物型生物标志物”，捕捉其描述潜在病理生理学的能力，同时不依赖于出现的临床表现。尽管尚无单一生物型标志物能够预测ALS、FTD或其交叉的出现，但开发生物型生物标志物谱的多模态方法有望检测相关病理生物学过程。这种方法的力量将通过同时解决恢复力/易感性问题（包括遗传风险易感谱和开发基因组及细胞衰老的敏感生物标志物）而增强。通过纳入这些非传统疾病标志物，不仅可以更全面地了解退行过程，还可以了解可能减轻或增加疾病高概率的因素。
items.frontierRationale: 该文基于2025年最新国际研讨会共识，聚焦ALS-FTD谱系疾病的病理生物学定义和生物型生物标志物开发，具有高度ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Acute-onset dysphagia: an uncommon presentation of myasthenia crisis.
items.summary: Myasthenia crisis is a lethal complication of myasthenia gravis, and about 20% of patients with myasthenia gravis may present for the first time in crisis. We present a case in which underlying, undiagnosed myasthenia gravis presented in crisis as acute-onset dysphagia. We would like to discuss the role of acute exacerbation of chronic rhinosinusitis and the administration of high-dose oral corticosteroids in the precipitation of the myasthenia crisis in this patient.

items.titleZh: 急性起病吞咽困难：肌无力危象的一种罕见表现
items.summaryZh: 本文报告一例以急性吞咽困难为首发症状的肌无力危象病例，患者此前未被诊断为重症肌无力。作者认为慢性鼻窦炎急性加重和口服大剂量激素可能诱发了危象。该病例提示，对于急性起病的吞咽困难，需将神经肌肉接头疾病（如重症肌无力）纳入鉴别诊断，尤其是在使用激素治疗时需警惕潜在重症肌无力被诱发加重。
items.insight: 该病例对ALS研究者有参考价值，因为吞咽困难是ALS常见且严重的症状，而此病例提示急性吞咽困难也可能源于神经肌肉接头疾病（重症肌无力危象），且激素使用可能诱发或加重病情。在ALS诊疗中，若患者出现急性或快速进展的吞咽困难，需考虑合并其他神经肌肉疾病或治疗相关因素，避免误诊和不当用药。

items.abstractZh: 肌无力危象是重症肌无力的一种致命并发症，约20%的重症肌无力患者可能以危象作为首次表现。我们报告一例潜在未确诊的重症肌无力患者，以急性起病的吞咽困难作为危象的首发表现。我们讨论慢性鼻-鼻窦炎急性加重以及大剂量口服皮质类固醇的应用在该患者肌无力危象诱发中的作用。

items.title: High-grade B-cell lymphoma presenting with bulbar palsy and Tapia syndrome: A case report.
items.summary: Bulbar palsy and Tapia syndrome (ipsilateral recurrent laryngeal and hypoglossal nerve palsy) are rarely the initial manifestations of lymphoma. Motor neuron disease is often the primary consideration in such cases, potentially leading to diagnostic delay. A 46-year-old male was admitted to the hospital on April 16, 2020, with the chief complaint of "dysphagia for 7 days." High-grade B-cell lymphoma. The patient received swallowing function rehabilitation training after admission. On May 12, 2020, a biopsy of a painful mass in the right mandibular area was performed. On May 20, 2020, systemic anti-tumor therapy was administered based on immunohistochemistry and FISH results. At the 2-month follow-up, the patient showed further weight loss, extensive extranodal and multi-organ involvement, indicating a poor prognosis. Lymphoma can present with isolated bulbar palsy and Tapia syndrome, mimicking motor neuron disease. Recognizing B symptoms and atypical neuroimaging findings is essential for early diagnosis. Furthermore, the etiology of carotid stenosis in lymphoma patients is often multifactorial, and treatment decisions must balance stroke prevention against bleeding and other tumor-related risks.

items.titleZh: 以延髓麻痹和Tapia综合征为首发表现的高级别B细胞淋巴瘤：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名46岁男性患者，以吞咽困难（延髓麻痹）和Tapia综合征起病，最初疑似运动神经元病，最终确诊为高级别B细胞淋巴瘤。该病例提示，当患者表现为类似ALS的延髓症状时，需警惕淋巴瘤等肿瘤性疾病的可能性，特别是伴有B症状（如发热、盗汗、体重下降）或影像学不典型时。患者预后较差，2个月时已出现广泛转移。
items.insight: 该病例对ALS研究者具有重要警示价值：延髓起病的运动神经元病是临床常见诊断，但本病例提示淋巴瘤可以完美模拟这一表现。对于表现为进行性延髓麻痹的患者，若病程进展速度、伴随症状（如疼痛性肿块、B症状）或影像学特征不符合典型ALS，应考虑肿瘤性疾病并进行针对性活检，以避免误诊和延误治疗。这也提醒ALS鉴别诊断中需纳入淋巴瘤等罕见病因。

items.abstractZh: 延髓麻痹和Tapia综合征（同侧喉返神经和舌下神经麻痹）很少是淋巴瘤的初始表现。此类病例常首先考虑运动神经元病，可能导致诊断延迟。一名46岁男性于2020年4月16日因“吞咽困难7天”为主诉入院。诊断为高级别B细胞淋巴瘤。入院后患者接受吞咽功能康复训练。2020年5月12日，对右下颌区疼痛性肿块进行活检。2020年5月20日，根据免疫组织化学和FISH结果开始全身抗肿瘤治疗。2个月随访时，患者体重进一步下降，出现广泛的结外和多器官受累，提示预后不良。淋巴瘤可表现为孤立的延髓麻痹和Tapia综合征，类似运动神经元病。识别B症状和非典型神经影像学发现对早期诊断至关重要。此外，淋巴瘤患者颈动脉狭窄的病因常是多因素的，治疗决策必须在卒中预防与出血及其他肿瘤相关风险之间取得平衡。

items.title: Serum Neurofilament Light Chain and GFAP in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis on a Commercial ECLIA Platform.
items.summary: In amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), SIMOA-based studies show that baseline serum neurofilament light chain (NfL) predicts the revised ALS Functional Rating Scale (ALSFRS-R) decline rate and survival. The Roche Elecsys electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (ECLIA) reports values approximately six-fold lower; cross-platform comparison confirms comparable performance, but serial clinical-practice data remain limited. We assessed whether ECLIA NfL correlates with the ALSFRS-R decline rate under the sampling conditions of clinical practice, and whether GFAP or S-100B adds prognostic or disease-specific information. We retrospectively analyzed 58 patients with medical-record-confirmed ALS at an academic center (2022-2026). Serum NfL, GFAP, and S-100B were measured on the Roche Elecsys ECLIA. The NfL-ALSFRS-R correlation was assessed within matching windows; serial NfL was examined in patients with repeat draws. First-per-patient NfL median was 7.06 pg/mL (IQR 4.06-17.30). NfL correlated strongly with the ALSFRS-R decline rate (Spearman r = 0.704, n = 31; r = 0.809 within 90 days, n = 17; both p < 0.0001). Fast progressors had 3.7-fold higher mean NfL than slow progressors (17.10 vs. 4.64 pg/mL). NfL showed no correlation with King's clinical stage (r = 0.00). GFAP correlated with age but not with progression rate or disease duration; S-100B showed no association with progression. Serum NfL on a commercial ECLIA platform retained its strong correlation with progression rate despite unstructured sampling, replicating SIMOA-based findings at platform-specific values. NfL tracked the rate of decline rather than the accumulated disease state; GFAP and S-100B added no prognostic or disease-specific information.

items.titleZh: 商业 ECLIA 平台上肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的血清神经丝轻链和 GFAP
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究在 58 例 ALS 患者中验证了罗氏商业 ECLIA 平台检测血清 NfL 的临床价值。结果显示，即使在非标准化的临床采样条件下，ECLIA 测得的 NfL 仍与 ALSFRS-R 下降速率强相关（r 达 0.7-0.8），快速进展者 NfL 水平约为缓慢进展者的 3.7 倍。NfL 反映的是疾病进展速率而非累积的疾病负担（与 King 分期无相关性）。GFAP 和 S-100B 未显示额外的预后价值。
items.insight: 该研究为 ALS 领域提供了关键转化证据：NfL 作为预后生物标志物的价值不依赖于昂贵的 SIMOA 平台，在临床广泛可用的商业 ECLIA 平台上同样成立，这大大降低了 NfL 检测的临床门槛，有望推动其成为常规临床监测工具。

items.abstractZh: 在肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）中，基于 SIMOA 的研究表明，基线血清神经丝轻链（NfL）可预测修订版 ALS 功能评定量表（ALSFRS-R）的下降速率和生存期。罗氏 Elecsys 电化学发光免疫分析（ECLIA）报告的值约低六倍；跨平台比较证实了相当的性能，但临床实践中的系列数据仍然有限。我们评估了在临床实践采样条件下，ECLIA NfL 是否与 ALSFRS-R 下降速率相关，以及 GFAP 或 S-100B 是否增加预后或疾病特异性信息。我们回顾性分析了某学术中心（2022-2026 年）58 例经病历确诊的 ALS 患者。使用罗氏 Elecsys ECLIA 测量血清 NfL、GFAP 和 S-100B。在匹配窗口内评估 NfL-ALSFRS-R 相关性；在重复采血患者中检查系列 NfL。每位患者首次 NfL 中位数为 7.06 pg/mL（IQR 4.06-17.30）。NfL 与 ALSFRS-R 下降速率强相关（Spearman r = 0.704，n = 31；90 天内 r = 0.809，n = 17；均 p < 0.0001）。快速进展者的平均 NfL 比缓慢进展者高 3.7 倍（17.10 对 4.64 pg/mL）。NfL 与 King 临床分期无相关性（r = 0.00）。GFAP 与年龄相关，但与进展速率或病程无关；S-100B 与进展无关联。尽管采样非结构化，商业 ECLIA 平台上的血清 NfL 仍保持其与进展速率的强相关性，以平台特异性值复制了基于 SIMOA 的发现。NfL 追踪的是下降速率而非累积的疾病状态；GFAP 和 S-100B 未增加预后或疾病特异性信息。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于 2026 年，直接验证了商业 ECLIA 平台在真实临床采样条件下 NfL 的预后价值，具有明确的转化意义，可加速 NfL 从研究工具走向常规临床实践。

items.title: Microbiota-derived metabolite-GPCR signalling in neurodegeneration.
items.summary: The gut microbiome acts as a primary regulator of host homeostasis, influencing the entire body through bidirectional communication along the gut-brain axis (GBA). Dysbiosis, which is defined as a state of microbial imbalance involving alterations in community composition and function, can disrupt the synthesis of important microbiota-derived metabolites, such as short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), bile acids and neurotransmitter precursors. This can lead to impaired essential host signalling pathways. There is growing evidence that metabolic alterations associated with dysbiosis contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative disorders (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), Huntington's disease (HD), multiple sclerosis (MS) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). In this context, G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) act as essential molecular transducers that link microbial metabolites to intracellular signalling networks. Aberrant GPCR activation, driven by altered metabolite profiles, modulates key downstream pathways including cAMP, MAPK, PI3K/Akt, NF-κB and Ca2 + signalling. This promotes neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction and pathological protein aggregation - hallmark processes underlying neurodegeneration. By identifying convergent and disease-specific signalling pathways, the review highlights mechanistic nodes of therapeutic relevance and discusses GPCR-centric emerging and other microbiome-targeted strategies aimed at restoring metabolic and signalling homeostasis in neurodegenerative disorders.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的微生物群衍生代谢物-GPCR信号传导
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦肠道微生物代谢物如何通过GPCR影响ALS等神经退行性疾病。核心观点是：菌群失调导致短链脂肪酸等代谢物异常，进而通过GPCR异常激活下游炎症、氧化应激和蛋白聚集通路。文章提出，靶向GPCR或恢复微生物代谢平衡可能成为ALS等疾病的治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述系统梳理了微生物-代谢物-GPCR轴在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中的共同机制，为ALS研究者提供了从肠道菌群和代谢角度理解疾病、寻找新靶点的整合框架，尤其值得关注GPCR作为可成药靶点的潜力。

aiRead.keyFinding: 菌群失调导致的代谢物变化通过GPCR异常激活，促进神经炎症、氧化应激和蛋白聚集，是ALS等神经退行性疾病的共同机制节点。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供新的实验数据；所讨论的机制和治疗策略多为临床前或概念性证据，缺乏临床验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对特定GPCR（如SCFA受体）或微生物代谢物调节在ALS动物模型及临床试验中的验证性研究。

items.abstractZh: 肠道微生物群是宿主稳态的主要调节因子，通过肠-脑轴（GBA）的双向通讯影响全身。菌群失调（定义为微生物群落组成和功能改变的失衡状态）可破坏重要微生物衍生代谢物（如短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、胆汁酸和神经递质前体）的合成，导致关键的宿主信号通路受损。越来越多的证据表明，与菌群失调相关的代谢改变有助于神经退行性疾病（NDDs）的发生和进展，包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、亨廷顿病（HD）、多发性硬化症（MS）和肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）。在此背景下，G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）作为关键的分子转导器，将微生物代谢物与细胞内信号网络连接起来。由代谢物谱改变驱动的异常GPCR激活，调节包括cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和Ca2+信号在内的关键下游通路，从而促进神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和病理性蛋白聚集——这些是神经退行性变的标志性过程。通过识别趋同和疾病特异性的信号通路，本综述强调了具有治疗相关性的机制节点，并讨论了以GPCR为中心的新兴策略及其他针对微生物组的策略，旨在恢复神经退行性疾病中的代谢和信号稳态。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的微生物组与GPCR信号研究，为ALS提供了从肠-脑轴代谢调控角度出发的转化研究新方向。
